svg.text: BLD-510B + 57BSD76-24-01 + KCD4 switch + 10K pot + DC jack + foot pedal
TN, SN, RN closed to T, S, R
All three open when a plug is in
Switch one way → ENA to GND (run), F/R open → clockwise
Switch center → ENA open → motor coasts to a stop (also clears an alarm)
Switch other way → ENA and F/R to GND → counterclockwise
Pause in the center until the flyer stops before reversing.
If S and Z are backwards, pop the switch out and flip it — the mount is symmetrical.
Pedal plugged in → panel pot fully disconnected, pedal PWM drives SV. Unplugged → panel pot works.
Plug or unplug with the switch centered. Both jacks wired the same: T = +5V, R = GND, S = signal.
⚠ Phase wires and hall wires are both Yellow / Green / Blue.
Phase leads are thick (20 AWG). Hall leads are thin (26 AWG). Don't mix them up.
Drawn for BLD-510B V2.0, where EN to GND = run. V2.4 inverts EN (runs when open).
If the motor runs with the switch centered, you have V2.4. See manual section 4.3.
Dots mark connections. Wires that cross without a dot are not connected.
